citationText: 1. The f/number is the relative aperture of the optic, e.g., for a 5-in. focal length, a 2. 50-in. glass diameter yields 2. 5/5 = f/2. 0. It also relates to the acceptance angle of the cone of light from the lamphouse, as the lamphouse also has an f/number. The smaller the f/number, the larger the “opening” or glass diameter for a given focal length.
